profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer & Founder | Software Architecture & 3D Pipelines | Computer Vision, Simulation & Physical AI
profile.summary:
I build perception systems for physical AI, end to end.
 
More than a decade in film and television, with 12 screen credits including Deadpool, Furious 7, The Little Mermaid, and House of Cards. Then spatial computing at Microsoft HoloLens and Meta Reality Labs, where I built synthetic data pipelines for computer vision at production scale.
 
I am the founder of Binary Core LLC. Robotics teams come to us with a perception problem: models that miss rare defects, deployments that reset the visual world, training data that cannot be collected. We sit down, understand the problem, and build the system that solves it, whatever the pipeline needs: physics accurate digital twins, synthetic training data with labels born correct, model training and evaluation, reinforcement learning in simulation, cloud deployment and real time inference. Some clients need one piece. Some need the whole pipeline running while they hire.
 
The craft comes from film: photorealism under deadline. The infrastructure comes from Microsoft, Meta, and years of production cloud engineering.
 
Binary Core's open source AI agent, BowerBot, orchestrates the pipeline through OpenUSD, Isaac Sim, Replicator, and Cosmos. Part of the ASWF landscape.
 
More at binarycore.us

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer & Founder
positions.description:
Founded Binary Core LLC and lead hands-on development of Physical AI tools for robotics and computer vision teams, covering simulation, digital twins, synthetic data, perception and robot learning on NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab and OpenUSD.
- Real-to-sim. Turned scans, CAD and Revit/BIM data of real spaces into physics-accurate Isaac Sim digital twins with OpenUSD, MaterialX, PhysX and RGB, depth and LiDAR sensors.
- Sim-to-real. Trained a parcel detector on 100% synthetic Replicator and Cosmos data and validated it on real drone footage.
- Trained robot policies in Isaac Lab with reinforcement and imitation learning for grasping, navigation and manipulation.
- Building end-to-end ROS 2 sim-to-real pipelines for quadrupeds, humanoids and industrial robot arms.
- Created BowerBot, an agentic AI ecosystem for OpenUSD with an open-source core and skills for Isaac Sim and other DCCs.

Clients can bring me onto their team as a contractor through Binary Core LLC, or hire the studio for fixed-scope projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Vision · Machine Learning · OpenUSD · Nvidia Omniverse · Digital Twins · PyTorch · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Synthetic Data Generation · Computer Simulations · Robotics

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Single-handedly architected and built the complete asset management platform from ground up:

• Designed and developed the full-stack ecosystem, owning both frontend and backend development

• Built intuitive UI/UX in Unity for seamless asset browsing, management, and workflow optimization

• Architected scalable backend infrastructure on AWS container services (ECS/EKS) for high-performance asset processing

• Designed and implemented database architecture for efficient asset storage, retrieval, and metadata management

• Developed comprehensive version control system for asset tracking, rollback capabilities, and collaboration workflows

• Managed end-to-end deployment pipeline, monitoring, and maintenance of the entire platform

• Delivered a production-ready, enterprise-grade solution as the sole engineer on the project

positions.title: Senior Python Developer
positions.description:
•	Working closely with cross functional teams (i.e. architects, data analysts, database administrators, business analysts) and play a key role in designing and developing a data warehouse; that includes building a backend application in the cloud.

•	Collaborate with Database Administrators, ETL developers and business stakeholders resulting in effective data driven solutions for the data warehouse.

•	Create new no supervised Machine Learning algorithms and compare predictions between them.
•	Create data pipelines for Machine and Deep learning process.

positions.title: Pipeline Technical Director
positions.description:
Responsible to build the entire pipeline and synchronize Nuke environment for compositing
artists, production version control, tools for VFX supervisor and tools for sound FX department.


• Designed, developed and implemented applications on Generic 3D Interface in data management. 
• Collaborated on constant workflow system, saving development time with the automatization of tasks 
   for visual effects process in the editorial and VFX production departments. 
• Involved in Developing a Restful service using Python Django framework. 
• Developed entire frontend and backend modules using Python on Django Web Framework.  
• Designed and managed API system deployment using fast http server and Amazon AWS architecture. • Developed views and templates with Python and Django's view controller and templating language to 
   create a user-friendly website interface. 
• Designed and implemented a dedicated MYSQL database server to drive the web apps report on daily 
   progress. 
• Collaborated with internal teams to convert end user feedback into meaningful and improved 
   solutions. 
• Develop and execute test plans, test cases, bug reports and scenarios for functional and regression 
   testing. 
• Asset Department reporting and added new features and fixed bugs.
• Perform positive and Negative testing by inputting valid and invalid data.
• Python OOP Design for manufacturing quality, monitoring, logging, and debugging code 
   optimization. 
• Dealing with client regarding the requirements of the projects and taking care of production issues 
   and bugs.

positions.title: Pipeline Technical Director
positions.description:
• Responsible to develop the pipeline for compositing artist and production environments, tool
  development and plugins for Nuke for compositing artists and visual effects supervisor. 
• Gather business requirement and converting business requirements to technical requirements. 
• Responsible for identifying stories/tasks and estimating efforts and timelines at granular level. 
• Responsible for Architecture and design implementation including database schema.  
• Designed, developed application using Python language and QT Framework, Data Management, and Backend server. 
• Developed web application using python and Django framework. 
• Worked on User Interface using Django templating and PyQt4.  
• Designed, developed front-end using Qt Framework and Qt Designer. 
• Involved in cloud application deployment using Nginx web servers on Amazon EC2. 
• Created test plans and detailed test cases for web tests to be performed with Python. 
• Developed the required XML Schema documents and implemented the framework for parsing XML documents. 
• Responsible for debugging and troubleshooting the web application using Subversion version control tool to coordinate team-development.

positions.title: Senior Python/Information Technology Development Analyst
positions.description:
• Users administration in active directories, workflow with ERP Oracle environment and Database 
   administration processed on quality assurance's environments for save and protect data in server. 
• Perform Data migration, Workflow guides and releases new data. 
• Design and Build Oracle Frontend with Oracle Forms tool and Oracle objects to create nightly jobs. 
• Performed some operations, visualization on Oracle DB using Matplotlib.
• Worked with Network related python libraries for transferring the files and connecting remotely to the 
   servers. 
• Used Cloud-watch for monitoring AWS cloud resources and the applications that deployed on AWS by 
   creating new alarm, enable notification service. 
• Sub Queries, Stored Procedures, Triggers, Cursors, and Functions on MySQL, PL/SQL and PostgreSQL 
   database and performed error and exceptional handling. 
• Test plans, test cases, test specifications and test coverage.

positions.title: Trainee / Jr. Software Engineer

• Created Python and Bash tools to increase efficiency of call center application system and operations;

• Built various graphs for business decision making using Python matplotlib library.

• Developed Views and Templates with Django view controller and template language to create a 
   userfriendly website interface 
• Implemented user interface guidelines and standards throughout the development and maintenance

• Wrote Datasets and Data tables into HTTP-serializable JSON strings. 
• Worked with different operating systems like Windows, Ubuntu, Linux and UNIX. 
• Created APIs, database Model and Views Utilization Python to build responsive web page application. • Strong Socket programming experience in Python. Implemented complex networking operations like 
   race route, SMTP mail server and web server. 
• Good experience in writing SQL Queries and implementing stored procedures, functions, packages, 
   tables, views, Cursors, triggers. 
• Developed and executed User Acceptance Testing portion of test plan.

projects.title: Magicshapes
projects.description:
MagicShapes is an educational game for kids aged 4-9 focused on reinforcement online learning, accessible for free through your web browser (desktop or laptop) and mobile device. Artware Games developed the idea in just 2 months during the COVID-19 lockdown. Based on logical reasoning each user can solve a game, by choosing a board of a different theme. The user can also select the level of difficulty on each game. They can also create their own boards with a theme of their choice and personalize it up to their liking.

MagicShapes is aiming to help parents and teachers educate the young students with a variety of boards like maths, planets, animals, languages and other subject taught in school. Each user can follow other users and learn from their personalized boards. That way MagicShapes is giving a social platform for both learning and leisure time certified kids friendly.
